notes: Rates are per kill/completion unless stated. 'NxA/B' means N independent rolls at A/B.
kind: rng (default) | guaranteed | common | derived | milestone. Only rng items (and groups/pity items) feed the luck maths.
max:1 means a second copy cannot drop (pets), so extra rolls after the first are ignored.
confidence: high = per-item rates taken from the OSRS wiki drop tables; partial = some rates missing/assumed; approx = equal-rate model calibrated to Temple's expected KC (no per-item rates yet).

abyssal_sire.note: Unsired (1/100) then a weighted table. The three bludgeon pieces share one pool (62/128 of Unsired) and are handed out without duplicates until the set is complete.

alchemical_hydra.name: Alchemical Hydra

scurrius.name: Scurrius
scurrius.note: Pet is MVP-only; this assumes the player is MVP (solo).

vorkath.name: Vorkath
vorkath.note: Vorkath's head is 1/50 and guaranteed by kill 50, so it is a pity item. The other rates (visages 1/5000, necklace 1/1000, jar/pet 1/3000) are from memory and not re-checked.

nex.name: Nex
nex.note: Rates as listed on the wiki; team size, contribution and MVP change the real unique chance, which is not modelled.

the_nightmare.name: The Nightmare
the_nightmare.note: Nightmare rates improve with team size (wiki gives a range); the better-end (large team) figures are used. Phosani's rates are fixed. The pity-free Slepey tablet is common.

phantom_muspah.name: Phantom Muspah
phantom_muspah.note: Shard/icon/cache rates are from the wiki; Saturated heart (1/150) and Muphin (1/2500) are from memory.

royal_titans.name: The Royal Titans
royal_titans.note: Rates assume full damage share on each titan. Prayer scrolls stop dropping once read.

hueycoatl.name: The Hueycoatl
hueycoatl.note: Rates assume a solo kill. Hueycoatl hide is common.

vardorvis.name: Vardorvis
vardorvis.note: Normal-mode rates (awakened has a 3x unique table and is not tracked separately by the hiscores). The vestige needs three qualifying rolls. Blood quartz scales from 1/200 to 1/50 over the first 300 kills until the first drop. Strangled tablet's scaling is not documented, so it is treated as common.

the_whisperer.name: The Whisperer
the_whisperer.note: Normal-mode rates. The vestige needs three qualifying rolls. Shadow quartz scaling assumed to match blood quartz (1/200 to 1/50 over 300 kills).

the_leviathan.name: The Leviathan
the_leviathan.note: Normal-mode rates. The vestige needs three qualifying rolls. Quartz/tablet items are treated as common because their scaling was not available.

yama.name: Yama
yama.note: Only the soulflame horn, oathplate pieces and Yami were available; remaining slots are treated as common.

tempoross.name: Tempoross
tempoross.note: Reward rolls scale with points, which isn't visible in KC, so no per-item model.

wintertodt.name: Wintertodt
wintertodt.note: Rewards scale with points, so no per-item model.

zalcano.name: Zalcano
zalcano.note: Rates scale with contribution; the better end of the listed range is used for the shard.

sol_heredit.name: Fortis Colosseum
sol_heredit.note: Unique rates depend on the wave reached and aren't published as per-item rates.

moons_of_peril.name: Moons of Peril
moons_of_peril.note: Per chest: 1/56 per moon defeated for a piece of that moon's set, handed out without duplicates. Assumes all three moons per run, so each set pool is 1/56 per chest.

the_fight_caves.name: The Fight Caves
the_fight_caves.note: Fire cape is guaranteed on completion. Pet is 1/200 off-task (1/100 on a TzHaar task, and sacrificing the cape gives another roll); off-task is assumed.

the_inferno.name: The Inferno
the_inferno.note: Infernal cape is guaranteed on completion. Pet is 1/100 (1/75 on a TzHaar task); off-task assumed.

the_gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
the_gauntlet.note: Normal and corrupted runs have different rates. Gauntlet cape is guaranteed on a corrupted completion.

chambers_of_xeric.name: Chambers of Xeric
chambers_of_xeric.note: Unique chance = personal points / 8,676 per cent (cap 65.7%). Uniques split by weight (normal /60, CM /56, the August 2026 weights). Olmlet is 1/53 per unique. Dust and kit are CM-only and need a timed clear.

theatre_of_blood.name: Theatre of Blood
theatre_of_blood.note: Team gets a unique with chance 1/9.1 (normal) or 1/7.7 (hard); one player receives it, so the personal chance is that divided by team size (assumption, default 4). Sinhaza shroud tiers are claimed at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 completions: milestones, not drops.

tombs_of_amascut.name: Tombs of Amascut
tombs_of_amascut.note: Unique chance = 1% per (10,500 - 20 x scaled raid level) points, capped at 55%. Weights are the base table (/24). Pet is 1% per (350,000 - 700 x raid level) points. Thread, jewels, breach and eye have pity scaling by KC. Icthlarin's shroud tiers are milestones; the crafting kit, ornament kit and phalanx are guaranteed at high raid levels. Points and raid level are assumptions you can change.

shared_treasure_trail_rewards.name: Shared Clues
shared_treasure_trail_rewards.note: Shared rewards come from every clue tier; KC is the total clues completed.
